## Arthur Schopenhauer quote sources

8 passages attributed to Arthur Schopenhauer in this archive, each with the locator that lets you find it in the work itself — and the one thing that most often goes wrong when people quote Schopenhauer.

[Quote source](https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source) / Arthur Schopenhauer

How to cite this author, and what circulates under the name that is not theirs to give.

### Sourcing profile

Language of the works

German

Cited here from

The World as Will and Representation (Vol. 1, and Book IV), Parerga und Paralipomena, and Aphorisms on the Wisdom of Life.

How to cite it

Name the volume as well as the work, and give the section number for Vol. 1 and the chapter for Vol. 2 — the two volumes are organised differently. The Aphorisms are a part of Parerga, not a separate book.

Where quotations of this author go wrong

Parerga und Paralipomena is a miscellany of essays, and the Wisdom of Life material that supplies most circulating Schopenhauer aphorisms is only one section of it. Citing the essays' own titles is the honest locator; citing the volume leaves a reader hunting through a very long book.

1 of the passages below have been worked through against the cited edition, with the original-language wording and the circulating variants recorded on their own pages.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Where can I check quotations attributed to Arthur Schopenhauer?

Name the volume as well as the work, and give the section number for Vol. 1 and the chapter for Vol. 2 — the two volumes are organised differently. The Aphorisms are a part of Parerga, not a separate book. This archive cites Arthur Schopenhauer from The World as Will and Representation (Vol. 1, and Book IV), Parerga und Paralipomena, and Aphorisms on the Wisdom of Life. Every passage listed on this page carries that locator, so it can be found in any edition of the work.

#### What is the most common mistake when quoting Arthur Schopenhauer?

Parerga und Paralipomena is a miscellany of essays, and the Wisdom of Life material that supplies most circulating Schopenhauer aphorisms is only one section of it. Citing the essays' own titles is the honest locator; citing the volume leaves a reader hunting through a very long book.

#### What language did Arthur Schopenhauer write in?

German. Any English sentence you read is a translation, so a complete source names the translator as well as the passage.
